mapper.select: select user_password from sys_user where 1=1 and user_id = #{userId}

select sys_id , store_name , address , phone_number , (select email from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}) as email , open_time , close_time from store_info si where 1=1
and si.store_name like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
and si.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and si.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update store_info set store_name = #{updateItems.storeName} , address = #{updateItems.address} , phone_number = #{updateItems.phoneNumber} , open_time = #{updateItems.opentime} , close_time = #{updateItems.closetime} , modify_datetime = now(), modify_user_id = #{userId} where 1=1 and sys_id = #{updateItems.sysId}
mapper.select: select sys_id , store_name , address , phone_number , null as email , open_time , close_time from store_info si where 1=1 and si.sys_id = #{sysId} and si.delete_yn = 'N'
